# Sandip Gangakhedkar - Fractional CTO & CPO

> London-based fractional technology and product leader helping startups and growth companies build exceptional products and teams.

## About Sandip

Sandip Gangakhedkar is an experienced technology and product leader offering fractional CTO and CPO services to startups and growth companies. Based in London, UK, he works with clients globally.

### Professional Background
- 20+ years in research, product development, and entrepreneurship
- Co-founder of Imperium Drive (autonomous driving) and Fetch (Europe's first tele-driven car hire)
- Former researcher at Bell Labs, Huawei, and Nokia (5G, network protocols)
- 20+ patents filed, published in top-tier scientific conferences
- Currently engaged with multiple AI and analytics startups/SMEs across the UK and US as a fractional CTO/CPO.

### Areas of Expertise
- Technology Leadership & Strategy
- Product Management & Development
- Startup Consulting & Advisory
- Software Architecture & Scalability
- Team Building & Scaling
- AI/ML & Agentic AI Systems
- Technical Due Diligence

## Services Offered

### Fractional CTO Services
Part-time Chief Technology Officer services for companies without full-time technical leadership. Includes technology strategy, architecture decisions, team building, and technical due diligence.

### Fractional CPO Services
Part-time Chief Product Officer services focusing on product strategy, roadmap development, product-market fit, and user experience optimization.

### Engagement Models

**Strategic Advisory** (Few hours/month)
- Monthly strategy sessions
- Roadmap reviews
- On-demand consultation for critical decisions
- Best for: Early-stage startups or companies with existing tech leadership

**Tactical Leadership** (20-30 hours/month)
- Hands-on team management
- Product development involvement
- Process implementation and optimization
- Best for: Growth companies scaling teams and technology

**Executive Partnership** (2-3 days/week)
- Comprehensive technology and product leadership
- Strategic planning and execution
- Team leadership and investor relations
- Best for: Companies without full-time CTO/CPO

## Industry Experience

- **Autonomy & Hardware**: Autonomous systems, IoT, robotics
- **Mobility & Transportation**: Connected vehicles, logistics, smart transportation
- **B2B SaaS & Platforms**: Enterprise software, APIs, scalable architectures
- **Data & Analytics**: Location intelligence, real-time processing, ML applications
- **AI-native Products**: Agentic AI workflows, AI architectures, evaluation systems

## Key Services

1. Technology Strategy & Roadmap - Align tech initiatives with business goals
2. Architecture & Scalability Planning - Design systems that grow with your business
3. Technical Due Diligence - Support fundraising and M&A activities
4. Product-Market Fit - Define and validate product strategy
5. Team Scaling - Hire, onboard, and structure high-performing teams
6. Process Optimization - Implement agile, DevOps, and QA practices
